review.missing_dependency: Missing PowerShell now causes a test error instead of the previous implicit success.
review.production_limit: A pass proves only behavior when the spawning test process has normal Ctrl-C processing. It does not repair or verify product behavior when a caller starts with the inherited ignore attribute set; the original preserve observation remains a real limitation until the product contract is decided and tested.
review.timeout_limit: 90s parent timeout does not extend the original nextest60s deadline. It is not a reliable cleanup guarantee after a hard nextest kill at60s: child-process destructors may not execute. This is a containment/diagnostic limitation, not evidence the original 10s assertions were relaxed.
review.shared_state: The child-only environment key and API call do not change parent globals. The original test body remains unchanged after shell resolution.
